caption: The image depicts a metallic object with a somewhat rectangular but wavy-edged shape. It is primarily gray in color and features six circular holes—three on the top edge and three aligned vertically below them—likely intended for screwing or attaching the object to another surface. Along the center of the object, the word "SENSIBLE" is cut out in all uppercase block letters, with each letter occupying its own vertical section. On the right end of the object, there is a protruding piece with a horizontal opening, resembling a buckle or attachment point. The object is set against a plain, off-white background, and the overall drawing style is realistic with attention paid to the metallic texture and shadowing.
